name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Trajectory-based 1–8 update input safety buffer inspired by the attached reference mod.

enabled.name: Enable Predictive Buffer
enabled.description: Turn predictive input delaying on or off without restarting. Turning it off immediately flushes queued input.

max-delay-frames.name: Maximum Delay (frames)
max-delay-frames.description: Search for the earliest safe input frame within this many game updates. If no safe candidate is found in this window, the original input passes through.
